newsitem.title: USA: Rexene rejected $16/shr bid from Huntsman.
newsitem.headline: Rexene rejected $16/shr bid from Huntsman.

text.p: Rexene Corp last month rejected a $16-per-share takeover bid from Huntsman Corp, according a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing by Rexene.
According to the filing, made last week, Huntsman made its bid on October 29 and the Rexene board rejected it on November 4.

The board "unanimously determined that Mr. Smith (Rexene chairman and chief executive) should contact Mr. Huntsman and advise him that the board believed that Huntsman should increase the purchase price it was proposing and modify the terms of the proposal to make the accomplishment of a transaction more certain for the Rexene shareholders," according to the filing.
